activities.name: SendMessage
activities.whenToUse: Use to submit a message through the selected registered provider. AzureFoundry and OpenAI use the same current send helper for both send labels; CodexCLI accepts Content or structured Prompt, optional flat OutputSchema and a configured ModelKey. Choose fields by current provider source; no provider response is assured by this guidance.
activities.description: Send a request to an intelligence service.

properties.description: Extract the message request configuration after adapter validation.
properties.whenToUse: Supply provider request configuration for SendMessage. The concrete adapter reads it after mapped validation; CodexCLI requires Config before resolving prompt/schema.

properties.description: Read the message Content input after preceding request validation.
properties.whenToUse: Supply text content when the selected provider's message path uses it. CodexCLI rejects nontext Content and a nonempty Prompt combination; Foundry rejects Content combined with Prompt.Texts, while OpenAI rejects Content combined with Prompt.

properties.description: Read Foundry MediaPath request input.
properties.whenToUse: For AzureFoundry only, supply a legacy local image path when no structured Prompt.Media entries are present. OpenAI's current send helper rejects Config.MediaPath even though its catalog association remains; CodexCLI uses Prompt.Media.

properties.description: Read Foundry MediaUrl request input.
properties.whenToUse: For AzureFoundry only, supply a legacy image URL when no structured Prompt.Media entries are present. OpenAI's current send helper rejects Config.MediaUrl despite its catalog association; CodexCLI uses Prompt.Media.

properties.description: Read and reject legacy Config.Model in current Foundry/OpenAI send helpers; use ModelKey.
properties.whenToUse: Omit this legacy model field for current AzureFoundry/OpenAI send helpers: both reject Config.Model and select the actual model through Config.ModelKey/profile settings. Its catalog context is retained as a validation read.

properties.description: Read the request ModelKey after preceding validation.
properties.whenToUse: Supply a configured model/profile key when selecting the provider's request profile. CodexCLI validates a nonblank key against runtime profiles and uses its default when omitted.

properties.description: Read CodexCLI OutputSchema input.
properties.whenToUse: For CodexCLI structured output, supply a flat closed object schema when a constrained JSON result is needed. The helper validates its supported keywords and scalar property types before execution.

properties.description: Validate output-schema $schema.
properties.whenToUse: For a CodexCLI OutputSchema, omit $schema or set the exact draft 2020-12 schema URI accepted by the validator.

properties.description: Validate output-schema additionalProperties.
properties.whenToUse: For CodexCLI OutputSchema, set additionalProperties false to keep the object closed; the validator rejects an open object.

properties.description: Validate output-schema properties.
properties.whenToUse: For CodexCLI OutputSchema, provide a flat object of named scalar properties. The validator requires this member and bounds its size.

properties.description: Validate a caller-named output-schema property object.
properties.whenToUse: For each literal CodexCLI schema property name, provide its property object. The name is a literal key, not a path expression or permission for arbitrary nested schema shape.

properties.description: Validate the scalar type of a caller-named output-schema property.
properties.whenToUse: For each CodexCLI schema property, choose one supported scalar type: string, integer, number, boolean or null. Nested or other types are rejected.

properties.description: Validate output-schema required.
properties.whenToUse: For CodexCLI OutputSchema, list every named property exactly once in required. The validator rejects missing, duplicate or unrelated names.

properties.description: Validate output-schema type.
properties.whenToUse: For CodexCLI OutputSchema, set the root type to object; the validator requires a flat closed object.

properties.description: Read CodexCLI Prompt input.
properties.whenToUse: For CodexCLI, supply a text or structured Prompt when Content is not used. Structured Prompt accepts System, Texts and Media; nonempty Prompt conflicts with nonblank Content.

properties.description: Read media inputs from the original structured prompt after validation.
properties.whenToUse: Supply structured media entries when the selected provider's prompt supports them. CodexCLI requires a list and validates entries; Foundry rejects combining populated structured media with legacy MediaPath/MediaUrl rather than replacing it. OpenAI uses structured media and rejects legacy top-level media fields.

properties.description: Read Detail from an original structured prompt media entry, after validation and only while original entries remain selected.
properties.whenToUse: For AzureFoundry/OpenAI structured image media, select a provider-supported Detail value when needed. For CodexCLI, omit Detail or leave it blank: its current media helper rejects every nonblank Detail value.

properties.description: Read MediaPath from an original structured prompt media entry, after validation and only while original entries remain selected.
properties.whenToUse: For a selected original structured media entry, supply a local MediaPath when media should be loaded from disk. CodexCLI validates text and media constraints before use.

properties.description: Read MediaType from an original structured prompt media entry, after validation and only while original entries remain selected.
properties.whenToUse: For a selected original structured media entry, set MediaType for the media kind. CodexCLI validates text and supported type before media resolution.

properties.description: Read MediaUrl from an original structured prompt media entry, after validation and only while original entries remain selected.
properties.whenToUse: For a selected original structured media entry, supply MediaUrl for remote media. CodexCLI validates text and allowed hosts/limits before download.

properties.description: Validate the value of an unsupported literal request member.
properties.whenToUse: CodexCLI reads literal extra media-entry member names only to reject unsupported members. Do not use this dynamic context as an arbitrary extension field; supported keys are MediaPath, MediaUrl, MediaType and Detail.

properties.description: Read the system input from the original structured prompt after validation.
properties.whenToUse: Supply system text in a structured Prompt when the selected provider accepts that channel. CodexCLI validates it as text before composing the request.

properties.description: Read text inputs from the original structured prompt after validation.
properties.whenToUse: Supply a list of text entries in a structured Prompt. CodexCLI rejects a scalar string or non-text list entries.

properties.description: Validate the value of an unsupported literal request member.
properties.whenToUse: CodexCLI reads literal extra Prompt member names to reject unsupported fields. Use only System, Texts and Media; this dynamic context is validation, not an extension point.

properties.description: Validate the value of an unsupported literal request member.
properties.whenToUse: CodexCLI reads literal extra Config member names to reject unsupported request fields. Use its supported Prompt, Content, ModelKey, OutputSchema and Break members; this is validation, not an extension point.

properties.description: Preserve conduction context when cloning the Foundry request.
properties.whenToUse: For AzureFoundry request cloning, retain an incoming parent Phase reference when conduction context must be preserved. This is not a message body field.

properties.description: Preserve conduction context when cloning the Foundry request.
properties.whenToUse: For AzureFoundry request cloning, retain an incoming parent Plan reference when conduction context must be preserved. This is not a provider payload field.

result.description: Outer JSON text. When local Codex CLI text/media execution and optional output schema; final response validated.
assistant constant [constant]. When local Codex CLI text/media execution and optional output schema; final response validated.
CLI final response [provider-returned]. When local Codex CLI text/media execution and optional output schema; final response validated.
Outer JSON text. When ApiKind OpenAIResponses; provider response normalized.
assistant constant in decoded JSON [constant]. When ApiKind OpenAIResponses; provider response normalized.
joined provider text [provider-returned]. When ApiKind OpenAIResponses; provider response normalized.

resultNotes: decoded.* is a documentation selector after parsing the outer JSON string, not a property of the returned string.
Intelligence_CodexCLI: Result is normalized JSON text, not a decoded object or proof the image was interpreted correctly
Intelligence_AzureFoundry: Outer result is JSON text; response values depend on bound provider. No live call made
Intelligence_OpenAI: native Responses result is normalized JSON text; no live provider call made

activities.name: SendMessageOriginal
activities.whenToUse: For AzureFoundry or OpenAI, this label currently reaches the same send helper as SendMessage, without a distinct transformation route. No CodexCLI property association is declared here; use current provider-specific content, model-key and media rules.
activities.description: Send through the same current AzureFoundry/OpenAI request helper as SendMessage.

properties.description: Extract intelligence service request configuration.
properties.whenToUse: Supply AzureFoundry/OpenAI request configuration for the original-message branch; the selected concrete provider reads it after mapped dispatch.

properties.description: Read Foundry Content request input.
properties.whenToUse: Supply content for the same current AzureFoundry/OpenAI send helper used by SendMessage. Foundry rejects combining it with Prompt.Texts; OpenAI rejects combining it with Prompt.

properties.description: Read Foundry MediaPath request input.
properties.whenToUse: For AzureFoundry only, supply a legacy local image path without populated structured Prompt.Media. Current OpenAI send helper rejects this legacy field despite the retained catalog association.

properties.description: Read Foundry MediaUrl request input.
properties.whenToUse: For AzureFoundry only, supply a legacy image URL without populated structured Prompt.Media. Current OpenAI send helper rejects this legacy field despite the retained catalog association.

properties.description: Read and reject legacy Config.Model in current Foundry/OpenAI send helpers; use ModelKey.
properties.whenToUse: Omit this legacy model field: current AzureFoundry/OpenAI send helpers reject Config.Model and select a profile through Config.ModelKey instead. The catalog retains this validation context.

properties.description: Read Foundry ModelKey request input.
properties.whenToUse: Select the AzureFoundry/OpenAI model profile key for the original-message request when provider configuration uses it.

properties.description: Read Foundry Prompt.Media request input.
properties.whenToUse: Supply structured prompt media entries for the current AzureFoundry/OpenAI send helper. Foundry rejects combining populated entries with legacy MediaPath/MediaUrl; OpenAI rejects those legacy top-level fields entirely.

properties.description: Read Foundry media Detail.
properties.whenToUse: For an original AzureFoundry/OpenAI media entry, set Detail when its selected media representation requires it.

properties.description: Read Foundry media MediaPath.
properties.whenToUse: For an original AzureFoundry/OpenAI media entry, supply MediaPath to load a local media file.

properties.description: Read Foundry media MediaType.
properties.whenToUse: For an original AzureFoundry/OpenAI media entry, identify its MediaType when the provider's media path uses it.

properties.description: Read Foundry media MediaUrl.
properties.whenToUse: For an original AzureFoundry/OpenAI media entry, supply MediaUrl when remote media is selected.

properties.description: Read Foundry Prompt.System request input.
properties.whenToUse: Supply original structured system text for AzureFoundry/OpenAI when that provider branch reads it.

properties.description: Read Foundry Prompt.Texts request input.
properties.whenToUse: Supply original structured text entries for AzureFoundry/OpenAI when that provider branch reads them.

properties.description: Preserve conduction context when cloning the Foundry request.
properties.whenToUse: For AzureFoundry request cloning, retain an incoming parent Phase reference to preserve conduction context.

properties.description: Preserve conduction context when cloning the Foundry request.
properties.whenToUse: For AzureFoundry request cloning, retain an incoming parent Plan reference to preserve conduction context.

result.description: Outer JSON text. When same OpenAIResponses call as SendMessage; provider response normalized.
When same OpenAIResponses call as SendMessage; provider response normalized.

resultNotes: Intelligence_AzureFoundry: Current source does not expose a distinct raw/original provider envelope
Intelligence_OpenAI: native Responses result is normalized JSON text; no live provider call made

activities.name: HandleMessage
activities.whenToUse: Use to resolve a message from ItemSignal at Plan.Path and optionally run a Format condenser activity on it. This branch is listed across providers; it handles an existing message rather than sending a new provider request.
activities.description: Resolve and optionally format a message.

properties.description: Extract intelligence service request configuration.
properties.whenToUse: AzureFoundry reads Config before HandleMessage dispatch as part of its concrete request validation; other listed providers do not have this contextual Config attribution.

properties.description: Resolve the message format after successful message lookup.
properties.whenToUse: Set a Format condenser activity when the resolved message should be formatted after lookup. Omit to keep the looked-up message without this optional conversion.

properties.description: Resolve the message lookup path for message handling.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the ItemSignal path containing the message to handle. The selected concrete adapter resolves this before optional formatting.

result.type: message native value or formatted value
result.description: When Path selects message; optional Format postprocessing; selected message resolves.
When Path selects response; optional Format postprocessing; selected message resolves.

resultNotes: Intelligence_AzureFoundry: success can have no Result (selected MessageSignal has no Result)
Intelligence_OpenAI: native Responses result is normalized JSON text; no live provider call made
